messages:
maria_ops: vendor sent an updated schedule for EU H100 top-off. lead time slipped 9d -> 16d for 24 units. can we re-prioritize allocations?
vikram_vendor: FRA customs backlog caused the delay. proposal: split shipment 12 air + 12 sea. air surcharge +€1,800/unit.
sophie_logistics: need AWB and depot handoff windows if split. tentative air AWB EY1234567890 to AMS, depot slot 2026-07-25 AM. sea ETA Rotterdam 2026-08-10.
maria_ops: @tyler_procure is the air premium acceptable vs using Dedicated warm spares?
tyler_procure: air premium for 12 ≈ €21.6k. suggestion: 8 air (critical customers), 4 warm-spare rotation, 12 sea. saves cost, minor provisioning delay for 4.
vikram_vendor: can pre-authorize 8 air. 4 warm-spare require 30% deposit on PO to reserve.
maria_ops: deposit OK. RMA question: DOA coverage for air shipments? depot buffer?
sophie_logistics: per contract vendor provides loaners within 48h for air, replacements via vendor RMA manifest. need HS code and depot damage photos.
rma-bot: automated: Vendor RMA SLA = 72h replacement commit post-DOA confirmation. upload evidence to https://rma.redwood/s/1799901110.
vikram_vendor: insurance note: claims > €50k need forwarder sign-off; recommend transit insurance on PO.
tyler_procure: will add INS: transit+all-risk and approve air premium for 8 units.
sophie_logistics: ETA summary for 8 air + 4 reserve warm-spare + 12 sea: 8 air -> 2026-07-25; 4 reserve -> vendor staging available 2026-07-28; 12 sea -> 2026-08-10.
maria_ops: action items: 1) @vikram_vendor send deposit invoice by EOD; 2) @tyler_procure add insurance and approve air uplift; 3) @sophie_logistics provide depot DOA SOP (photo checklist + manifest.csv).
vikram_vendor: invoice sent to finance@redwood as INV-5301, deposit net7.
tyler_procure: finance to finalize payment, air uplift approved for 8 units.
sophie_logistics: DOA intake SOP snippet:
- seal photo (box id)
- serial vs PO compare
- power-on test (15m)
- photo of failed POST logs
- attach manifest.csv with AWB and serials
DEPOT TAG: AMS-WARM-3
maria_ops: can vendor pre-tag serials for preloading golden image to save ~45m/unit?
vikram_vendor: yes, we can include preload metadata in manifest.csv (preload=ubuntu-24.04-golden-v2). sample manifest will follow.
maria_ops: thanks everyone. i'll update provisioning playbook and allocations sheet. ping here if status changes. :thumbsup:
